entities.summary: Bassianae or Bassiana was an important ancient Roman town in Pannonia. It was located near present-day Donji Petrovci, a village in the Ruma municipality. Bassianae was the second largest town in Syrmia, after Sirmium. It was located on a road that connected Sirmium and Singidunum.
